sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The Ticket is a story chapter in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text: Use the buttons below to select the ending you want to pursue.

sections.heading: Arrive at the entrance pathway to the port Terminal
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Notes |
| Reprogrammed RFID keycard with Mr. Kerman's hash codes | 1 | Used only for the Savior ending. |
| RFID keycard with unknown name | 1 | Used only for the Debtor ending. |
| Prapor's letter for the port checkpoint | 1 | Used only for the Survivor ending. |
| Reprogrammed RFID keycard with Prapor's hash codes | 1 | Used only for the Fallen ending. |

You will have to use the corresponding access item on the keycard swiping system, or the intercom call button for the Survivor ending on the intercom between the times 21:00 and 06:00. The corresponding access item will be accepted and the intercom will tell you to proceed to the gate. If you do not have a proper access item, or it is the wrong time of day, the guard will deny you entry via the intercom.

sections.heading: Access the port Terminal
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Notes |
| Secure container Alpha-1 with TerraGroup evidence | 1 | This item is only needed if you are doing the Savior ending. |

If you are authorized to approach, you will have to follow the left road to approach the transit area. Once you approach the transit area, your weapon will be automatically lowered. You won't be able to transit without having Secure container Alpha-1 with TerraGroup evidence in your task inventory if you are doing the Savior ending.

A few actions can get you killed by the port garrison:
- Going further than the first anti-tank barrier without presenting an access item.
- Going outside of the road around the transit area.
- Pulling out a weapon, or getting a weapon back in your hands after it has been lowered.

sections.heading: Notes:
sections.text:
- If you die with the Secure container Alpha-1 with TerraGroup evidence, a new one will be sent to you via in-game mail.
- The RFID keycard with unknown name can be purchased once per raid from Lightkeeper for 1× TerraGroup "Blue Folders" materials. Note: Free special slot required.
- Prapor's letter for the port checkpoint can be purchased twice per trader reset from Prapor for 5,000,000 Roubles.

sections.heading: Pass the security check
sections.text: The security check consists of a cinematic of you entering the Terminal area.

sections.heading: Locate the armory with your confiscated equipment
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Notes |
| Armory key | 1 | Needed to open the armory door. |

You will need to find your way to the armory building, and enter the armory to retrieve your equipment. You will have to find the corresponding key on your way to the armory. Once you have retrieved your equipment and have exited the armory to the west, a squad of Black Division operatives will approach the armory building from the southwest. You will have to fight them in order to continue to the next objective

sections.heading: Obtain the keycard to unlock the service passage
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Notes |
| Black Division keycard | 1 | Needed to open the service passage later in the raid. |

You will have to find the Black Division keycard located inside the seaport Terminal building (MS) west of the armory. The keycard is in a Weapon box (6x2) on a tipped over ATM. You will have to fight a squad of Black Division operatives guarding the inside of the building before getting the keycard.

sections.heading: Access the Terminal loading zone
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Notes |
| Black Division keycard | 1 | Needed to open the service passage in admin building (D3). |

To access the loading zone, you will have to get through the admin building. You will have to fight Scavs on the path to it and a team of Black Division operatives waiting at the entrance of the building. Once all Black Division operatives have been neutralized, you have to enter the building and swipe the Black Division keycard at the scanner next to the door. There are several resupply resources (Provisions, medical items) scattered about in the hallway immediately inside the door. Scavs spawning ahead will attempt to enter the hallway from the far end while you are inside.

sections.heading: Locate the way into the fuel depot
sections.text:
| Related Quest Items |
| Icon | Item name | Amount | Notes |
| SZ-1 explosive charge (Terminal) | SZ-1 explosive charge | 1 | Only needed if:; You are alone.; Your Strength skill isn't at Elite level. |

To continue, you must get through the metal gate blocking your path. You can do this by either using a nearby found SZ-1 explosive charge to open the door, by pushing it open with Elite level Strength, or by pushing it open together with another player.

You will have to fight a squad of Black Division operatives around the various SZ-1 explosive charge spawns. It is recommend to clear them first before looking for the charge.

sections.heading: Drain the water in the pumping station
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid | Notes |
| Toolset | 1 | Required* | N/A | This item is used for a guaranteed repair of electrical panels. When used, the item is not removed from the players' inventory. |
- Electrical panels can be repaired with bare hands, but the chance to succeed is low. If you fail a repair, the panel will inflict damage to your arms.

You will need to find and repair one to five electrical panels scattered around Terminal in order to restore power to the pumping station. The amount of panels that are required to be repaired depends on the number of players in the raid:
- Solo players will always have a single panel to repair (Either panel number 9 or 10).
- With 2-5 players, at least 1, but up to 5 panels will need to be repaired across all panel locations.

Two Toolsets can be found on Terminal in static locations, both are guaranteed to spawn every raid.

sections.heading: Obtain the key to the gate blocking the road to the pier
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Notes |
| Pier door key | 1 | Required to access the Pier where the Zubr Boat extraction is located. |
The key can be obtained from a safe inside the pumping station, only after draining the water.

sections.heading: Locate the exit leading to the pier
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Notes |
| Pier door key | 1 | Required to access the Pier where the Zubr Boat extraction is located. |

You now need to access the pier to reach the Zubr Boat extraction. You can reach the door to the pier in a few ways:
- You can go through the container loading bay in the east, this avoids fighting the Scav Boss that can spawn, but requires backtracking, and is a longer path. (Green path)
- You can go through the container loading bay in the center, but you might have to fight the Scav Boss that can spawn, in addition to the team of Black Division operatives nearby. (Blue path)
- You can go through the container loading bay in the west, sticking close to the water, this may avoid fighting the Scav Boss that can spawn, but can end up in a long distance battle with a squad of Black Division operatives at the end of the loading bay. (Purple path)

On all possible paths, you will have to fight squads of Black Division operatives before reaching the pier door.

sections.heading: Escape from Tarkov
sections.text:
Once the Pier door has been opened, all players in the raid will have 3 minutes to reach the Zubr Boat extraction at the end of the pier before the extraction becomes unavailable regardless of the current raid time left. You will have to fight a final team of Black Division operatives on the pier, before reaching the boat. The extraction timer coincides with the three minute timer, once the timer is up, any players in the extraction zone will escape and a cinematic related to the ending you chose will start.

Successfully completing the raid will allow you to obtain one of the game's endings. Upon dying or extracting, the state of your character is returned to what it was before entering Terminal, besides the consumed access item.
